title: Brief
description: Stage 3 output (brief.json). The build plan for tonight's piece. Must be about the research, name and discard the obvious idea, follow mood.creative_parameters, and use nothing on plan.banned. Rules JSON Schema cannot express (novel_technique membership, storyboard coverage, mechanism name matching the dossier) are checked by the harness.

concept.description: One sentence. Used for shingled concept similarity in novelty gate A.

mechanism_name.description: Must equal the name of one dossier.visualisable_mechanisms entry.

how_visualised.description: How the mechanism appears on screen or in sound, so a liner-note reader can see it.

discarded_obvious_idea.description: The obvious first idea, named and explicitly discarded, with why.

compo.description: Must equal plan.compo. One of: 4k-shader, 16k-demo, audiovisual, interactive-toy, data-sculpture, kinetic-type, simulation, constraint-night.

constraint_honoured.description: How the plan.constraint is honoured on constraint-night. Null otherwise.

techniques.description: Techniques the piece uses. None may appear in plan.banned.techniques.

novel_technique.description: A technique absent from the ledger entirely. Must also appear in `techniques`.

technique_family.description: Family of the main technique, for habituation and the boredom rule.

palette.description: Explicit palette, 2 to 8 colours, each '#RRGGBB' hex (for example '#1a2b3c'). Checked against plan.banned.palette_hexes by hue distance.

storyboard.description: Exactly 4 beats covering 0 to 20 s in order: beginning, development, development, ending.

memorable_moment.description: The one thing a viewer will remember.

self_declared_risk.description: What is most likely to go wrong.

liner_note.description: Published note, at most 120 words: concrete, sourced, no hype vocabulary (liner-notes skill).
